variation: Two matching dumbbells picked up using a deadlift, carried with short controlled steps, and set down under control.
camera: Fixed front-side three-quarter, full body and both dumbbells, space around feet.
beats: Hinge and bend knees; grip both weights.
Stand tall; brace with shoulders packed down.
Walk forward with short, controlled steps.
Keep weights steady and your chest tall.
Stop walking before lowering the weights.
Hinge and bend knees; lower without dropping.
